lessons.scriptText:
WRS LESSON PLAN - SUBSTEP 2.1
Group: Allen Angel 2.1
Lesson 1
Reader 2 | Level AB

BLOCK 1 - Word Study

1. Sounds Quick Drill

Vowels: short vowels: ă, ĕ, ĭ, ŏ, ŭ
Consonants: b, c, ch, ck, d, f, g, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, qu, r, s, sh, t, th, v, w, wh, x, y, z
Welded/Glued and Exceptions: all, am, an, ang, ing, ong, ung, ank, ink, onk, unk
Prefixes Known: n/a
Latin Bases Known: n/a
Suffixes Known: -s, -es

2. Teach & Review Concepts

a. Review Words / trouble spots
riches, nuts, calls, foxes, luns, cheds

b. Current Words
long, hang, king, wing, thing, lung, ring, sang

3. Word Cards Activity

a. Review Word Cards
riches, nuts, calls, foxes, luns, cheds
prefix: n/a
suffix: current suffix pattern
Latin base: n/a

b. Current Word Cards
long, song, rang, sing, thing, sang

4. Wordlist Reading (Independent)

Reader 2, page 2 (AB)
long, song, rang, sing, thing, sang, lung, wing, rung, hang, bang, king, gang, hung, ring
Goal: 12/15 for accuracy, 14/15 for fluency, 12/15 under 35 seconds for automaticity.

5. Sentence Reading

Use Reader 2, page 9 (AB).
High-frequency words: would, were, asked, her, who, should, could, now, how, ng
I would ring that bell at six.
Were you the one who sang that song?
Val asked Tim to get her a ring.
Ling got her ping pong balls back.
Ming let the cat on the back deck.
You should not bang on that tin box.
I asked the king for a job.
I could hang this long rod on the wall.
Will Kim sing her song now?
How does the king have such bad luck?


Extra page words for extension
link, rink, rank, think, sank, sink, honk, bank, dunk, tank

BLOCK 2 - Spelling

2. Teach & Review Concepts (Part 2)

long, song, rang, sing, thing

6. Quick Drill in Reverse

Say sounds for: short vowels: ă, ĕ, ĭ, ŏ, ŭ; b, c, ch, ck, d, f, g, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, qu, r, s, sh, t, th, v, w, wh, x, y, z; all, am, an, ang, ing, ong, ung, ank, ink, onk, unk

7. Teach & Review Concepts for Spelling

Read the base word first, add the suffix, then read and spell the complete word.

8. Dictation

Sounds
b, c, ch, ck, d, f, g, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, qu, r, s, sh, t, th, v, w, wh, x, y, z; short vowels: ă, ĕ, ĭ, ŏ, ŭ; all, am, an, ang, ing, ong, ung, ank, ink, onk, unk

Words
long, song, rang, sing, thing

Phrases
her six cats
were at the
dock how do

Sentence
Ron rang the bell at one.

BLOCK 3 - Fluency / Comprehension

9. Controlled Passage

Use Reader 2, page 14 (AB) for the official passage.
Optional teacher-created quick passage using current charting words:
First, read long, song, and rang.
Then read sing, thing, and sang.
Last, reread lung and wing for accuracy.

10. Comprehension Question

What did the student need to read?

Teacher Move
Follow the standard routine for 2.1: review, teach, read, spell, then transfer to sentence and passage reading.
